source_text: Introduxit me in cellam vinariam; ordinavit in me caritatem. Cella vinaria mysteria passionis et eucharistiae. Ordinavit caritatem: non tumultuariam, sed ordinatam — primum Deus, deinde proximus. Fulcite me floribus, stipate me malis, quia amore langueo.
pass_a_gloss: He-brought-in me into cellar wine; he-ordered in me charity. Cellar wine mysteries of-passion and of-eucharist. He-ordered charity: not tumultuous, but ordered...
pass_b_english: [[He brought me into the wine cellar; he ordered love in me >> Bible:Song of Songs 2:4]]. The wine cellar is the mysteries of the passion and of the eucharist. He ordered love: not chaotic, but ordered — first God, then neighbor. [[Stay me with flowers, heap me with apples, for I languish with love >> Bible:Song of Songs 2:5]].
